svg.aria-label: Eight panels: 1 standardized service contract, services communicate through well-defined standard interfaces; 2 loose coupling, service A and service B interact through a contract; 3 abstraction, a service exposes a simple interface and hides its implementation details; 4 reusability, three apps use one customer service; 5 autonomy, each service is developed, deployed and managed independently; 6 statelessness, a client sends a request and gets a response with no client state kept; 7 discoverability, a consumer discovers services in a registry that holds the provider service information; 8 composability, a composite service combines services A, B and C
